description: When the agent successfully pushes commits while working on an issue (sourceType = issue_comment), open a PR automatically via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls. Title: derived from the issue title. Body: links back to the originating issue ('Closes #{number}'). Base: the repo default branch. Head: the Otto branch. Update the status comment with the PR number and URL on success. This does not apply to PR sources (pr_conversation_comment, pr_line_comment) — those already have an open PR.
title: PR creation for implement_issue tasks
